title: Interactive Neural Computers
abstract: arXiv:2611.32811v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Computers and their interfaces are usually treated as fixed, so a person, or increasingly an AI agent, must adapt to whatever the operating system presents. This is limiting when someone needs a different workflow, or an interface suited to hands-free use or a disability. We explore an overlooked alternative. Rather than training an agent to operate an existing computer, we train a generative model to be the computer, predicting each next screen from past screens and the user's mouse and keyboard actions. Treating a desktop as an interactive world model raises problems that natural-video world models largely avoid. Without a camera pose to index memory, the model must remember content that has left the screen without any geometric cues. Arithmetic in a terminal has to be exactly right, not merely plausible. translated_abstract: 计算机及其接口通常被视为固定的，因此用户——以及越来越多的AI智能体——必须去适应操作系统所呈现的一切。当人们需要不同的工作流程，或需要一个适合免手操作或残障人士使用的界面时，这种设计就成了限制。我们探索了一种被忽视的替代方案：与其训练一个智能体去操作现有的计算机，不如训练一个生成模型来充当计算机本身，根据过去的屏幕画面以及用户的鼠标和键盘操作来预测下一屏画面。将桌面视为一个交互式世界模型会带来自然视频世界模型大多可以规避的问题：在没有相机位姿来索引记忆的情况下，模型必须记住那些已经离开屏幕的内容，且没有任何几何线索可循；终端中的算术运算必须完全正确，而不仅仅是看似合理；小的界面文本还必须以交互式帧率保持清晰可读。我们的交互式神经计算机（Interactive Neural Computer）在结构上类似于神经……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出不再训练智能体去操作现有计算机，而是训练一个生成式世界模型直接充当计算机，根据历史屏幕画面和用户的鼠标键盘操作预测下一屏画面，从而解决记忆索引、精确计算和小文本清晰度等独特挑战，实现可定制、无障碍的交互式界面。
en_tdlr: Instead of training an agent to operate an existing computer, this paper proposes training a generative world model to be the computer itself—predicting each next screen from past screens and the user's mouse and keyboard actions—while tackling unique challenges in memory indexing, exact computation, and legibility at interactive frame rates.
